in_hebrew.name: Jehius
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is He
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jehius הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Hebrew roots ‘Yah’ (God) and ‘Us’ (He), Jehius means ‘God is He’ or ‘Jehovah is God’. This name carries a strong connection to the Christian faith and biblical tradition.

in_greek.name: Jehius
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is He
in_greek.long_meaning: Jehius είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Hebrew roots ‘Yah’ (God) and ‘Us’ (He), Jehius means ‘God is He’ or ‘Jehovah is God’. This name carries a strong connection to the Christian faith and biblical tradition.

in_latin.name: Jehius
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God is He
in_latin.long_meaning: Jehius est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Hebrew roots ‘Yah’ (God) and ‘Us’ (He), Jehius means ‘God is He’ or ‘Jehovah is God’. This name carries a strong connection to the Christian faith and biblical tradition.
